title: Liver / metabolic module — scaffold (collaboration starter for Carolin Schneider)
status: scaffold v0 — anchor edges PubMed-verified; proposed edges to curate with collaborator

edges.rationale: Fetuin-A is an endogenous TLR4 ligand; FFA-induced inflammation/IR needs both FetA and TLR4
TLR4 inflammatory signalling drives lipid-induced insulin resistance (links to muscle PRRs->catabolism, MUS-063)
Selenoprotein P (hepatokine) inactivates AMPK, impairing insulin signalling in hepatocytes and myocytes
SeP causes systemic insulin resistance; KO/knockdown improves insulin sensitivity and glucose tolerance
Hepassocin/FGL1 impairs muscle insulin signalling via EGFR/JNK (already in MUS as MUS-049)
Cirrhotic hyperammonemia raises muscle myostatin via NF-kB (already in map; the hepatic->muscle sarcopenia bridge)
Fatty liver raises hepatokine secretion (Fetuin-A, SeP, FGL1, LECT2)
hepatic SeP mRNA correlates with insulin resistance
GDF15 rises in liver disease (secretory aging marker)
LECT2 hepatokine links obesity to skeletal-muscle insulin resistance (Lan 2014 Diabetes; PMID not retrievable via tools here)
hyperinsulinaemia/IR drives hepatic DNL (feed-forward to steatosis)
DNL contributes to hepatic fat accumulation
cirrhotic hepatocyte failure impairs urea-cycle ammonia detoxification
intact urea cycle clears ammonia; its failure raises it
bile acids activate FXR; FXR axis modulates hepatic lipid/glucose metabolism
FXR signalling restrains lipogenesis (candidate intervention node, e.g. FXR agonists)

for_schneider: Priorities to co-develop: (1) confirm/complete the hepatokine panel (Fetuin-A, SeP, FGL1, LECT2, GDF15) and their muscle/adipose targets; (2) the ammonia-urea-cycle-myostatin sarcopenia axis (your cirrhosis/sarcopenia domain); (3) MASLD progression and candidate intervention nodes (FXR agonists, resmetirom). Anchor edges are primary-verified; proposed edges need your domain curation + PMIDs.
